notes:
Summary: Ironcrest is a regulated payments processor evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for a multi-tenant inference layer inside their AWS landing zone. Key asks: SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning for automated user onboarding; fine-grained RBAC surfaced in Redwood Console/control plane tied to AD groups; customer-managed KMS (HSM) for model request encryption at rest; audit logging exported to Splunk/ELK with 1yr retention and immutable logs for e-discovery. Data residency requirement: EU regional tenancy for EU customer data; global routing policy for NA workload routing. Cost sensitivity moderate — willing to commit to Dedicated/Private if can guarantee throughput and predictable unit economics.

Selected quotes from stakeholders: "We cannot accept vendor-held keys for EU payment data." — Head of InfoSec. "We want group-based RBAC so ops can lock down model access per BU." — SRE lead. "SCIM must support nested groups and externalId mapping to AD objectGUID." — Identity engineer.

POC details: 4-week POC scoped to run a support-agent/chat workload + embeddings for document search (2M tokens/month). POC acceptance criteria: SAML login working for 5 pilot users; SCIM provisioning of 50 users + groups; RBAC mapping enforces deny-by-default for model deployment; KMS envelope integration proof; audit logs delivered to Splunk endpoint. Success -> procurement/contracting. Failure points: missing SCIM attributes, KMS cert mismatch, unresolved DPA clause.

Stubs/Links: security questionnaire uploaded to Drive, Fireflies recording for architecture call referenced, pricing deck link shared.
